scope.licenses: Admitted source subsets have pinned source terms; unknown-license code was excluded.
scope.content_quality: Full selected-corpus scan plus high-precision automatic exclusions and manual stratified review.
scope.cross_source_deduplication: Observed exact/normalized family closure across selected sources and old FineWeb.
scope.benchmark_decontamination: Bound benchmark signature and normalized overlap scans passed for the selected material.
scope.family_disjoint_splits: Rejected reserved families were replaced deterministically and moved out of training.

limitations: Admission is bounded to these content hashes and this screen protocol.
Quality filtering does not prove factual correctness of every document.
Decontamination and family closure do not detect every semantic paraphrase.
